claimCard.falseClaim: European intelligence services estimate that Ukraine's armed forces will be depleted within a year.
claimCard.grainOfTruth: Ukraine faces recruitment challenges due to ongoing conflict and population factors.
claimCard.canonicalDebunk: There is no evidence supporting the claim that European intelligence services have made such an assessment. This assertion originates solely from Russian intelligence sources, which have a history of disseminating unverified information. Ukraine continues to maintain a substantial pool of military-age citizens and has implemented measures to address recruitment challenges, including salary increases and recruitment abroad. These facts contradict the claim of imminent manpower exhaustion.
